title: Canadian Tax Accountant / Canadian BK (Full-time)
description:
Senior Accountant / Tax Accountant / Bookkeeper



Remote | Canadian Accounting Experience | Full-time



tech-forward cloud accounting firm based in Toronto, Canada. Our fully remote team works across multiple countries and time zones, combining cloud accounting, automation, and tax expertise to help clients manage their finances better and keep more of their hard-earned money.



Role Overview



We’re looking for a motivated accounting professional with Canadian accounting experience who wants to grow with the firm.



This role may be a fit if you come from one of these backgrounds:



1. Canadian Bookkeeper / Senior Bookkeeper

You have strong full-cycle bookkeeping, month-end close, QBO/Xero, and client accounting experience, and you’re willing to learn Canadian tax.



2. Canadian Tax Accountant / Tax Preparer

You already have Canadian tax exposure, such as personal tax, corporate tax, GST/HST, or year-end filings, and want to deepen your tax skills further.



4. Big 4 / Audit / Public Accounting Background

You may not have deep bookkeeping or tax experience yet, but you have strong accounting fundamentals, review discipline, attention to detail, and the ability to learn both bookkeeping and tax workflows quickly.



The ideal person is accurate, detail-oriented, coachable, and comfortable working in a remote accounting firm environment.



Key Responsibilities

You may be involved in some or all of the following, depending on your background and training path:

Perform accurate and timely bookkeeping, including A/P, A/R, GL, bank feeds, credit card feeds, and reconciliations

Handle full-cycle bookkeeping and month-end close using QuickBooks Online or Xero

Assist in preparing year-end financial statements and working papers

Support the preparation of Canadian personal tax returns, corporate tax returns, and GST/HST filings

Review client files for errors, discrepancies, missing information, or unusual transactions

Communicate with clients to gather documents, clarify transactions, explain variances, and provide basic accounting/tax planning support

Help maintain clean, organized, and well-documented client files

Support automation, cloud accounting tools, and process improvements

Coach junior tea
mbers and participate in weekly team calls

Communicate clearly in a remote, asynchronous work environment



Qualifications

Must Have

Experience in Canadian accounting, bookkeeping, tax, audit, or public accounting

At least 3 years of accounting, bookkeeping, tax, audit, or finance-related experience

Strong attention to detail and ability to identify errors, discrepancies, and missing information

Comfortable working with numbers, reconciliations, reports, and client financial data

Strong written and verbal communication skills

Ability to explain financial information in simple, plain English

Good time management skills and ability to handle multiple client files or deadlines

High ethical standards and commitment to client confidentiality

Willingness to learn and grow further in Canadian tax and cloud accounting

Strongly Preferred

3 to 5+ years of hands-on full-cycle bookkeeping and month-end close experience

Experience using QuickBooks Online or Xero

Experience preparing or supporting Canadian tax filings, including T1, T2, GST/HST, or year-end working papers

Prior experience in a Canadian accounting firm, bookkeeping firm, tax firm, or public accounting environment

CPA completed or in progress







You may be a strong fit if you are:

A Canadian bookkeeper who wants to grow into tax

A Canadian tax accountant who wants to strengthen tax depth and advisory skills

A Big 4, audit, or public accounting candidate who can learn bookkeeping and tax processes quickly

A detail-oriented accountant who can handle client work accurately without needing constant follow-up

Someone who is comfortable with cloud tools, remote work, and continuous learning



Why Join Us

Work with a modern, tech-forward Canadian accounting firm

100% remote setup across multiple time zones

Opportunity to grow your Canadian tax and accounting expertise

Exposure to a diverse client base, from startups to professional corporations

Competitive salary plus performance pay

Ongoing training and learning opportunities

Chance to help shape the firm’s systems, tools, and workflows as we grow



To APPLY: answer the following screening questions along with your cv/resume link



### Screening Questions



1. Can you walk me through your accounting, bookkeeping, tax, audit, or public accounting experience?

 Please include the type of company or firm you worked with, your role, the clients or industries you supported, and the main accounting or tax tasks you personally handled.



2. Which profile best matches your background? Please choose one and explain your fit.

   A) Canadian bookkeeping experience and willing to learn Canadian tax

   B) Canadian tax experience and willing to grow further in tax

   C) No Canadian bookkeeping/tax experience, but with Big 4 audit, public accounting, or strong accounting experience and willing to learn Canadian bookkeeping and tax



3. If you selected Profile A or B, please describe your Canadian accounting or tax experience.

 What Canadian clients, filings, bookkeeping tasks, tax returns, GST/HST work, year-end work, or accounting firm tasks have you handled?



4. If you selected Profile C, please describe your Big 4, audit, public accounting, or strong accounting background.

What types of clients did you handle, what accounting areas did you review or prepare, and why do you think your background can transfer well into Canadian bookkeeping and tax work?



5. Can you describe your hands-on experience with full-cycle bookkeeping, month-end close, reconciliations, year-end work, or tax filings?**Please mention the tools you used, such as QuickBooks Online, Xero, Dext, Hubdoc, Excel, Power BI, or other accounting/tax software.



6. Tell us about a time you found an error, discrepancy, missing document, or unusual transaction in a client’s books, audit file, or tax file. **What did you notice, how did you investigate it, and how did you resolve or escalate it?



7. This is a remote role that may require working Canadian business hours, which can mean night shift. Have you worked night shift, Canadian hours, or US hours before? If yes, can you commit to EST hours?

title: Performance Marketing Manager (100% Remote)
description:
We are not hiring someone to oversee campaigns.

We are hiring someone who leads performance, owns strategy, and drives growth that clients can measure every single month.

Who We Are

We are a performance-driven digital marketing team running high-budget campaigns across Google Ads and Meta Ads for clients in Asia and Europe. We are scaling fast and need a senior marketing manager who can take full ownership of our paid media operations and raise the standard of everything we deliver.

What You Will Lead

Full strategic ownership of paid campaigns across Google Ads and Meta Ads. Monthly budget management of $50,000 or more across multiple client accounts. Performance targets — ROAS, CPA, and revenue growth — set and delivered consistently. Conversion tracking infrastructure across GA4, GTM, Meta Pixel, and CAPI. Creative strategy and testing frameworks to continuously improve ad performance. Clear, honest monthly reporting with insights and a forward plan for every account. Collaboration with a distributed remote team across multiple time zones.

You Are the Right Person If You:

Have 4 or more years of senior-level performance marketing experience across Google and Meta. Have managed combined monthly budgets of $50,000 or more across multiple accounts. Have led campaigns that scaled profitably and can walk us through the decisions that drove it. Know GA4, GTM, Meta Pixel, and CAPI at a deep technical level. Think strategically, act decisively, and communicate clearly in English. Operate with full independence — you set priorities, manage your workflow, and own every outcome. Have experience managing or mentoring a team is a strong advantage.

What We Offer

100% remote — work from anywhere in the world with full schedule flexibility. Senior-level compensation based on your experience and the results you deliver. Real autonomy — you lead the strategy, not just execute it. A high-performance team that respects expertise and moves fast. Real budgets, high-value clients, and measurable impact every month. A clear path to Head of Performance as the team scales.

Compensation: Senior level and fully negotiable. We start at your current rate and grow from there based on results.

How to Apply

Send your CV and a performance summary to: 

Subject Line: [Performance Marketing Manager] - Full Name - Ready to Lead

Please include the following in your

title: Legal Admin Clerk / Paralegal Support
description:
Legal Admin Clerk / Paralegal Support | Sydney Legal Business | Work From Home

Please read this job post from top to bottom before applying.



We are only looking for applicants who carefully read the full post and follow the application instructions. If you apply without following the instructions at the bottom, your application will not be considered.



We are a Sydney-based legal business in the personal injury and a
 space, looking for an organised, proactive, and detail-focused Legal Admin Clerk / Paralegal Support tea
mber to join our Philippines-based remote team.



This is a work-from-home, full-time contractor role, working Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 5:00pm Sydney time.



About The Role

This is not an outbound sales or dialling role.



Your main responsibility will be to work through a pending list of signed-up potential clients where important information is still outstanding.



These matters cannot move forward properly until the required information has been received, reviewed, and followed up. Your role is to help move these matters from a pending list into active client files that can be allocated to the Sydney legal team.



This means you will be constantly reviewing files, identifying what is missing, following up with the right people or organisations, updating notes, and making sure matters keep progressing.



You may be required to communicate with clients, internal tea
mbers, superannuation funds, insurers, medical clinics, doctors, previous employers, and other relevant third parties to request or follow up on information required for a legal matter.



Key Responsibilities

Your day-to-day work will include:



Reviewing pending client files and identifying outstanding information

Following up with clients and relevant third parties

Liaising with our Philippines-based team who originate the matters

Communicating daily with our Sydney-based legal team

Keeping detailed notes on every file

Updating systems clearly and accurately

Helping move matters from pending status to active legal files

Supporting Sydney-based lawyers with administrative and paralegal-style tasks

Staying organised across multiple matters at the same time

Following up consistently until the required information is received

The key measure of success in this role is your ability to reduce the pending list and keep legal matters moving forward.



Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:



Highly organised and detail-focused

A strong written and spoken English communicator

Able to work autonomously from home

A self-starter who can think on their feet

Comfortable following up regularly and professionally

Able to manage a busy workload without losing track of details

Confident speaking on the phone when required

Reliable, consistent, and process-driven

Comfortable working with lawyers, admin teams, and external parties

Able to keep excellent notes and file records

Looking for a long-term role in a structured legal business

This role requires exceptional English and communication skills. You must be able to communicate clearly with Australian-based lawyers, clients, and external organisations.



Technical Requirements

You must have:



A reliable high-speed internet connection

A quiet and professional work-from-home setup

A reliable computer

Confidence using online systems, Slack,
, and cloud-based tools

The ability to demonstrate your internet speed if requested

How The Team Works

You will work closely with our Philippines-based team and our Sydney-based legal team.



The business is managed through Slack channels, internal systems, and structured workflows. You must be comfortable working online, keeping the team updated, and maintaining clear records of your work.



This is a very important role because it helps ensure that legal matters do not sit idle and that clients can move forward through the legal process.



There is real room to grow for the right person.



Compensation And Benefits

We offer:



Attractive compensation for the role

Long-term opportunity with a stable business

Work-from-home arrangement

Supportive team environment

Clear structure, training, and systems

Two weeks paid Christmas vacation, prorated depending on start date

Paid time off over Easter

Major Australian public holidays included

Opportunity to grow within the business

This is a contractor position. You will be responsible for your own tax obligations, government contributions, healthcare, insurance, and any other personal contractor obligations in the Philippines.



Important Application Instructions

To apply, please attach:



Your updated CV

A short cover letter explaining why you are suitable for this role

In your cover letter, please include:



Your legal admin, paralegal, or administrative support experience

Your previous work history and any relevant roles

Why you are highly organised and suited to managing pending files

Why your English and communication skills are strong enough for this role

Confirmation that you can work Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 5:00pm Sydney time

Confirmation that you have reliable high-speed internet

Your application subject line must include: TPD Matters Admin



Applications that do not include this in the subject line, or do not attach both a CV and cover letter, will be ignored.



We are looking for people who want a serious, long-term role and who can follow simple instructions carefully.

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
MACHSHIP	Remote — Philippines

MachShip  ·  Full-time  ·  Day shift  ·  Work from home



:alarm_clock:  6:30 AM – 3:00 PM PH time, Mon–Fri	:zap:  APIs · JSON · FTP/SFTP	:office:  B2B SaaS · Freight tech



ABOUT THE ROLE

MachShip is an Australian cloud-based Freight Management System helping logistics businesses automate and integrate their operations. As we scale our integrations function, we’re looking for a technically capable support specialist to own the delivery and support of customer integrations — end to end.

This is not a generic helpdesk position. You’ll scope, configure, and deliver real integrations for MachShip customers, troubleshoot issues across eCommerce and ERP platforms, and provide clear technical guidance to customers building their own solutions. You’ll work directly with customers and collaborate closely with our engineering and onboarding teams — with increasing independence as you grow in the role.



WHAT WE’RE OFFERING

•	Permanent work-from-home with long-term stability

•	Day shift — 6:30 AM to 3:00 PM PH time, Monday to Friday

•	Real technical challenges with a clear growth path

•	Collaborative AU/PH team with regular check-ins and monthly 1-on-1s

•	Ownership of documentation and process improvement

•	Supported learning and professional development



WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING



Integration delivery

–	Triage and scope new integration enquiries — data flows, endpoints, authentication, testing

–	Configure integrations using prebuilt connectors in our integrations tool

–	Coordinate UAT, go-live, and cutover activities with customers

–	Provide post-go-live support and handle enhancements within scope	Technical support

–	Troubleshoot integration issues using Postman and browser dev tools

–	Analyse and validate JSON, XML, and CSV payloads

–	Help customers interpret API responses, auth requirements, and error patterns

–	Escalate confirmed platform defects with clear evidence and reproduction steps

Customer & stakeholder comms

–	Manage tickets in line with agreed SLAs and customer impact

–	Communicate clearly on progress, timelines, and resolutions

–	Advise customers on best practices — retries, idempotency, monitoring	Documentation & knowledge

–	Create and maintain runbooks, FAQs, and troubleshooting guides

–	Contribute to internal playbooks covering common integration patterns

–	Identify recurring issues and improve public documentation



AI-assisted work:  We actively use AI tools to support troubleshooting, log interpretation, response drafting, and documentation. You’ll be expected to use these tools to work faster and smarter — while maintaining a strong underlying technical understanding of what you’re doing.



PLATFORMS YOU’LL WORK WITH

You’ll regularly work across a range of eCommerce and ERP systems including:



Shopify   ·   WooCommerce   ·   BigCommerce   ·   Magento   ·   NetSuite   ·   Cin7   ·   Unleashed   ·   Neto   ·   MYOB



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

•	2+ years in a technical support, implementation, or integration delivery role — SaaS experience preferred

•	Hands-on experience with REST APIs (authentication, payloads, error handling) and FTP/SFTP

•	Comfortable reading, validating, and mapping JSON, XML, and CSV data

•	Proficient with API tools like Postman or browser dev tools

•	Familiarity with eCommerce platforms (Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce) or ERP systems (NetSuite, Cin7)

•	Clear, professional written English — you communicate technical issues to non-technical customers confidently

•	Strong ownership mindset — you see tickets through to resolution and follow threads until you find the root cause

•	Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience



HOW TO APPLY



1.	Submit your application via our form at 
/integrations-support (password: support). Include a cover letter that speaks to your experience with integrations, your communication approach, and why this role suits your background — we read every one.

2.	Complete a short technical assessment — shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a practical task that reflects real work in this role.

3.	Video interview — final-stage candidates will meet with our team to discuss your experience, the role, and what day-to-day life at MachShip looks like.

The ideal candidate should be proactive, deadline-driven, and capable of handling rapid campaign deployment while maintaining accuracy and quality across deliverables.

1. Campaign Setup & Execution

- Build, launch, and monitor marketing campaigns across
, blogs, landing pages, social media, and press releases

- Support campaign deployment from planning through execution

- Assist in launching POV campaigns including blog content,
 marketing, social media posts, and press releases

- Maintain accurate campaign tracking for reporting and attribution purposes

Prepare and monitor campaign performance reports including:

-
 performance (open rates, CTR, engagement)

- Support faster campaign execution within 24–72 hours for rapid campaigns

- Assist in managing 6–10 concurrent campaigns effectively

- Improve campaign consistency, tracking, and reporting accuracy

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field preferred

- Experience in marketing support, campaign coordination, or digital marketing is an advantage

- Familiarity with HubSpot or similar CRM/marketing automation platforms preferred

- Strong organizational and project management skills

- Excellent attention to detail and ability to work under tight deadlines

- Strong written and verbal communication skills

- Ability to multitask and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

- Analytical mindset with comfort in reviewing campaign data and performance metrics

- Basic skills in graphic design and image editing using tools such as Canva, Adobe Photoshop, or similar platforms 

- Ability to create simple marketing visuals while following brand guidelines and campaign objectives



Performance Success Indicators

- Timely campaign launches and execution speed

- Accuracy of HubSpot campaign setup and reporting

- Number of campaigns successfully managed in parallel

- Lead generation and campaign contribution to pipeline growth

- Process improvement and optimization recommendations

title: Inbound Sales Specialist
description:
Inbound Sales Specialist / Callback Closer, No Cold Calling



We are hiring a confident English-speaking sales rep to handle inbound callbacks from US contractors and close them into monthly trials.



This is not cold calling.



Our team leaves short voi
s for contractors. When they call back, your job is to answer live, take control of the conversation, explain our missed-call service, handle objections, and help interested contractors start a paid monthly trial.



Our service helps contractors avoid losing jobs when they miss phone calls. If they are busy on a job and cannot answer, our team answers the missed call, captures the customer’s name, number, job type, and location, then texts the job information to the contractor immediately.



This is a sales role. We are looking for someone who is friendly, confident, persuasive, and comfortable asking for the sale.



Your Responsibilities:



Answer inbound callbacks quickly

Speak confidently with US contractors and business owners

Follow a simple sales script

Ask qualification questions

Explain the missed-call service clearly

Handle basic objections

Sell the monthly trial

Send setup/payment links by SMS

Stay on the phone while the prospect opens the link when possible

Log notes in the CRM

Follow up with interested prospects

Transfer hot prospects when needed



We Are Looking For Someone Who:



Has strong spoken English

Has phone sales, appointment setting, or closing experience

Is comfortable asking prospects to take action

Can handle objections without getting nervous

Sounds calm, friendly, and confident

Can follow a script without sounding robotic

Has reliable internet and a quiet work environment

Can work US business hours

Has BPO voice, inbound sales, outbound sales, appointment setting, or customer service experience



This is a good fit if you:



You like selling

You are confident on the phone

You can stay calm when people are busy, skeptical, or confused

You can ask for payment or setup without being awkward

You like performance bonuses

You want a long-term full-time role with growth potential



This is not a good fit if you:



You are afraid to sell

You only want a customer support role

You avoid asking prospects to buy

You get nervous when people ask questions

You cannot work night shift Philippines time

You have poor internet or background noise



Pay:



$4-$6/hour depending on experience, plus performance bonuses for paid trials started.



Strong performers can earn more.



To Apply:



Please send:



Your resume

A short voice recording introducing yourself

Your sales, appointment setting, or BPO voice experience



Position starts next week full-time

Remote Appointment Setter (Philippines)  

Company: R3 Athletic PT (US-based Physical Therapy Clinic)

About R3 Athletic PT  

We’re a sports-focused physical therapy clinic in the United States that helps active adults stay in the game, avoid surgery, and move pain-free with 1:1 care. We grow through Google/Yelp/Meta ads and referrals, and we need a dedicated, metrics-driven setter to convert leads into booked in-person evaluations.



Role Overview  

Your job is simple and very important:  

Turn new and old leads into **showed** appointments on our calendar.



You will:  

- Respond to new leads *within minutes*  

- Call, text, and follow up with leads using proven scripts  

- Qualify them and *book them into our schedule* with our front-desk system  

You are not closing treatment plans. Your success is measured on appointments booked and show rate



Key Responsibilities  

- Call, text, and follow up with all new leads from:  

  - Google ads, Yelp, Meta, website forms, and referrals  

- Respond to every new lead within *5 minutes* during working hours  

- Follow a proven cadence for unresponsive leads (multiple calls + texts over several days)  

- Ask simple qualifying questions (pain issue, activity level, timeline, location)  

- Confidently explain our free / low-barrier evaluation and what to expect  

- Book appointments directly into our calendar (we use Go High Level + Jane App / clinic software)  

- Re-activate old leads and past patients during slower times  

- Confirm next-day appointments via SMS / call to boost show-up rate  

- Maintain clean notes and tags inside the CRM  

- Track and report your daily metrics in a simple sheet (calls, contacts, bookings, show-ups)



Success Metrics (Your Scorecard)  

- Average response time to new leads  

- Number of outbound calls & texts per day  

- Appointments booked per day / week  

- Show-up rate for booked appointments  

- Re-activated / rebooked past leads



Requirements  

- Based in the Philippines, reliable high-speed internet, backup power/connection  

- Strong spoken and written English; neutral or clear accent on calls  

- Experience in any of the following is a plus:  

  - Appointment setting / inside sales  

  - Healthcare, fitness, or wellness customer service  

  - Using CRMs (Go High Level or similar)  

- Comfortable on the phone, can handle objections, and follow a script  

- Obsessive about:  

  - Replying fast  

  - Following up multiple times  

  - Updating CRM and tracking your own numbers  

- Coachable, honest, and hungry for a stable long-term role



Compensation & Benefits  

- Competitive monthly salary (in USD, paid via Wise)

- Performance bonuses tied to appointments *set and showed*  

- Paid PH holidays (aligned with agreement)  

- Training, scripts, and coaching provided  

- Long-term role with growth into senior setter or team lead for the right person



How to Apply  

 
 with the subject:  

`R3 Setter – [Your Name] – Philippines`



Include:  

1. Your CV (PDF)  

2. A 1–2 minute voice recording introducing yourself and answering:  

   - Why do you want a full-time appointment setter job?  

   - Tell us about a time you converted a lead when they were hesitant to move forward

3. Your internet speed test link (speedtest.net)  

4. Your expected monthly salary in USD

Have short, natural conversations

Identify interested prospects

Clear, neutral English

Sounds natural (not robotic)

Comfortable guiding conversations

This role requires:



speed

confidence

conversational control

Performance bonuses per successful setup



HOURS

35 hours/week

Must align with US hours

9 PM - 4 AM local time Philippines Time

To apply, send:



Voice recording (30–60 sec)



Your experience with outbound calling

title: Construction Accountant
description:
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:



1. Core Construction Accounting

*Maintain accurate job cost accounting across all active projects

*Prepare and manage Work-in-Progress (WIP) schedules, including revenue recognition and cost tracking

*Track retainage, committed costs, and budget vs. actual performance

*Ensure alignment between Procore (or PM systems) and Sage 300

*Support job “buyout” tracking and subcontractor financial coordination



2. Cash Flow & Financial Visibility (CRITICAL FOCUS)

*Develop and maintain cash flow projections at both company and project levels

*Provide leadership with clear, timely insight into cash position and future needs

*Assist in identifying risks related to margin erosion, cost overruns, or delayed collections

*Partner with leadership and fractional CFO/Controller to improve financial forecasting

*This directly addresses current gaps where high-level financial oversight and cash flow clarity are needed.



3. Accounts Payable & Subcontractor Management

*Manage AP workflows including vendor invoices, approvals, and payments

*Oversee subcontractor compliance (lien waivers, insurance, documentation)

*Coordinate payments tied to project funding and draw schedules

*Resolve discrepancies with vendors and internal teams



4. Month-End Close & Reporting

*Execute month-end close processes, including:

**Journal entries

**Bank and credit card reconciliations

**Job cost reconciliation

*Prepare and deliver:

**WIP reports

**Cash flow reports

**AP/AR aging

**Job profitability summaries

*Ensure reporting is accurate, timely, and actionable for leadership



5. Systems & Process Improvement

*Identify inefficiencies and implement improvements in:

**Accounting workflows

**Data accuracy between systems (Sage, Procore, etc.)

*Help establish repeatable processes and reporting frameworks

*Support implementation of automation and AI tools where applicable

*Aligns with company interest in improving systems and integrating AI into operations.



6. Collaboration with Operations & Leadership

*Act as a financial partner to:

**Operations (project execution, buyouts, cost control)

**Estimating (historical cost data, accuracy)

*Support leadership in protecting margins and making informed decisions

*Participate in regular reporting cadence (weekly/monthly financial updates)



7. Team Support & Continuity

*Provide support and backup for existing accounting personnel

*Help document processes to reduce dependency on any single tea
mber

*Assist in onboarding and training additional accounting support (including offshore resources if applicable)

*Important due to current reliance on key personnel and need for redundancy.



SUCCESS METRICS (KPIs)

*Accuracy and timeliness of WIP reporting

*Visibility and reliability of cash flow forecasts

*Reduction in accounting-related project issues (billing, cost tracking, etc.)

*Improved alignment between accounting and operations

*Consistency in monthly close timelines

*Reduction in leadership intervention needed for financial clarity



EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS REQUIRED:

*Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

*Active CPA license preferred.

*Minimum 5 years of progressive experience in accounting, with at least 2 years in the construction industry.

*Expertise in public accounting, specifically serving construction clients and managing multiple client accounts.

*Strong proficiency in accounting systems (e.g., Sage 300, TimberScan) is required. Experience with project management tools such as Procore is highly preferred

*Deep understanding of construction accounting standards, including WIP reporting, retainage, and cost allocation.

*Passion for delivering exceptional client service and fostering lasting client relationships.

*Excellent organizational and time-management skills to balance multiple client priorities.

*Strong leadership and team development capabilities.

*Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

*High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

*Ability to communicate complex financial concepts to non-financial stakeholders.



Tech Requirements:

*Computer - at least i5 or equivalent with 8gb RAM

*Internet Speed - At least 50 MBPS Download speed



Job Type: Part-time

Schedule: Monday to Friday 8:30 AM – 12:30 PM CDT - Monday to Friday 9:30 PM to 1:30 AM PHT

Salary Range: Php 40,000 - Php 55,000 monthly, Depending on experience



Application Instructions

Please fill out this form:


/appqNAvkEQ10YFlc3/pagqwxmsDSuQGHrJo/form

After submitting the form, click the apply button and send us a short message on why you would be a good fit for the role.

title: Supply Chain Associate (Amazon)
description:
Zoyava (www.zoyava.co) is positioned to establish itself as a leading digital-native brand, rapidly growing its market presence. Our dedication to delivering top-notch, user-friendly supplements exclusively on Amazon underscores our commitment to unparalleled quality and an exceptional customer experience across all operations. We firmly believe that each employee's contribution is absolutely indispensable to driving our company's advancement and success.



Who we’re looking for:



We’re currently looking for a Supply Chain Associate to join our team. This role is crucial for ensuring the efficient and effective management of our supply chain operations, particularly focusing on our Amazon FBA logistics, procurement processes, and inventory management. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of creating shipments and labels for Amazon FBA, alongside extensive experience in procurement, including supplier communications, negotiations, and purchase order placement. If you are organized, possess strong communication skills, and are capable of maintaining a well-structured digital filing system, we would love to hear from you.



Key Responsibilities & Duties:



- Handle all elements of Amazon FBA logistics, such as creating shipments, generating labels, and ensuring compliance with Amazon's policies and procedures.

- Conduct procurement activities, including supplier sourcing, negotiation, and purchase order placement. Ensure cost-effective procurement while maintaining quality standards.

- Establish efficient communication channels with suppliers to monitor order progress, address any issues, and oversee supplier partnerships.

- Effectively monitor and control inventory levels to meet demand and avoid unnecessary overstocking. Employ inventory management software to accurately track stock movements and accurately predict future requirements.

- Maintain the company's digital filing system with meticulous organization, ensuring all supplier-related documents and paperwork are accurately filed and easily accessible.



Requirements, Skills & Qualification:



- 3-5 years of FBA shipment experience

- Logistics experience creating and coordinating shipments

- Warehouse/3PL order submission and reconciliation experience

- Must have hands-on experience creating shipments and labels for Amazon FBA. The candidate should be familiar with Amazon Seller Central and have a solid understanding of FBA requirements and procedures.

- Procurement and Supplier Management: Demonstrated experience in procurement, including direct communication with suppliers, negotiation skills, and effective placement of purchase orders. The ability to build and maintain positive relationships with suppliers is essential.

- Strong proficiency in using cloud storage services (e.g., Google Drive) for document management.

- Effective verbal and written communication skills crucial for dealing with suppliers, internal teams, and managing documentation.

- Ability to manage and track inventory levels, ensuring stock availability and minimizing overstock situations. Experience with inventory software and forecasting tools is preferred.

- Attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously are key.



What We Offer:



- A dynamic and supportive work environment in a fast-growing company. We are dedicated to partnering with career-driven individuals in search of stable, fulfilling employment opportunities.

- We offer an attractive salary and comprehensive benefits package to ensure that our employees are well-compensated and rewarded for their hard work.

- Unlimited Paid Time Off

- Opportunities for advancing your professional growth and development.

title: Instructors Needed: Expand Knowledge with NovaArte
description:
Instructors Needed: Expand Knowledge with NovaArte



Online Course Instructors Needed for NovaArte Learning Platform



We are currently seeking passionate and knowledgeable online instructors to create and publish courses on our growing e-learning platform, NovaArte.



NovaArte is a modern online education marketplace focused on helping students worldwide learn valuable real-world skills through high-quality video courses, downloadable resources, and interactive learning experiences.



We are looking for instructors in areas including but not limited to:



* Business & Entrepreneurship

* Marketing & Social Media

* Programming & Web Development

* AI & Automation

* Graphic Design & Video Editing

* Music Production

* Language Learning

* Finance & Investing

* Fitness & Health

* Photography

* Candle Making & Handmade Crafts

* Cooking & Food Preparation

* Gaming

* Personal Development

* Military Skills & Leadership

* Technology & IT Certifications



## Responsibilities



* Create engaging online video courses

* Record lessons with clear audio/video quality

* Upload course materials and resources

* Structure lessons in beginner-friendly formats

* Interact with students when necessary

* Help grow the NovaArte learning community



## What We Offer



* Revenue sharing opportunities

* Instructor profile branding

* Long-term partnership potential

* Global audience exposure

* Flexible schedule

* Ability to publish multiple courses

* Future promotional support through our marketing campaigns



## Preferred Qualifications



* Experience teaching online or in-person

* Strong communication skills

* Ability to explain topics clearly

* Comfortable recording video lessons

* Existing audience or social media following is a plus



## Important Notes



* You retain rights to your original course content unless otherwise agreed upon

* We are interested in both single-course creators and long-term instructors

* Beginners with strong expertise are welcome to apply



When applying, please include:



1. Your area of expertise

2. Examples of previous work or teaching experience

3. Links to any portfolios, YouTube channels, or social media

4. Topics you would like to teach

5. Estimated timeline for course completion



## Course Length & Structure Requirements



To maintain quality and consistency on NovaArte, instructors should follow these general course guidelines:



### Mini Courses



* Length: 30 minutes to 1 hour

* Best for quick tutorials, introductions, or single-skill lessons

* Recommended lesson count: 5–15 lessons



### Standard Courses



* Length: 1 to 3 hours

* Best for beginner-to-intermediate learning

* Recommended lesson count: 10–30 lessons



### Masterclass Courses



* Length: 3 to 10+ hours

* Best for deep-dive professional training and certifications

* Recommended lesson count: 25–100+ lessons



## Lesson Guidelines



* Individual lessons should ideally be between 3–15 minutes long

* Courses should include:



* Video lessons

* Downloadable resources when applicable

* Assignments or exercises (optional but encouraged)

* Course thumbnails/banner images

* Clear section organization



## Video Quality Standards



* Minimum recommended resolution: 1080p

* Clear microphone audio required

* Screen recordings should be readable and professional

* Webcam presence is optional depending on the course style



## Suggested Course Formats



* Talking-head instruction

* Screen-share tutorials

* Slide presentations

* Workshop demonstrations

* Real-world project walkthroughs

* Hybrid teaching styles



High-quality, engaging, and well-structured courses are more likely to receive platform promotion and higher student enrollment.



We are building a serious long-term education platform and are looking for motivated instructors who want to grow with us.



Apply now and become one of the founding instructors on NovaArte.

title: Recruitment Coordinator
description:
Overview

We are seeking a proactive and highly organized Recruitment Coordinator to support our talent acquisition team and ensure a seamless experience for candidates and hiring teams. This role is critical to keeping our hiring process running smoothly, from scheduling interviews to managing candidate communications and supporting reporting and recruiting operations.



Key Responsibilities

- Candidate Sourcing: We are obsessed with finding highly qualified and relevant leads across our various positions. You will be leading outreach, follow up and sourcing campaigns on up to 4 roles at one time. 

- Interview Coordination: Schedule phone, video, and onsite interviews across multiple time zones; liaise with candidates and internal stakeholders to confirm logistics.



- Candidate Experience: Serve as the primary point of contact for candidates throughout the interview process; ensure timely communication and a white-glove experience.



- ATS Management: Maintain up-to-date candidate records in the applicant tracking system (ATS); post and update job descriptions as needed.



- Reporting & Metrics: Assist in preparing weekly recruiting reports and pipeline summaries; track key hiring metrics like time-to-fill and candidate conversion.



- Hiring Team Support: Coordinate feedback collection, manage interviewer guides, and ensure timely debriefs post-interview.



- Onboarding Prep: Collaborate with People Ops or HR to ensure a smooth handoff from offer acceptance to onboarding.



- Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve candidate flow, communication, and team coordination.



Qualifications

- 1–3 years of experience in a recruiting or administrative coordination role

- Exceptional organizational and time management skills

- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

- Familiarity with ATS platforms (e.g., Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby) and scheduling tools (e.g., Calendly, GoodTime) a plus

- Detail-oriented with a service mindset and a passion for delivering excellent candidate experience



Preferred Attributes

- Prior experience supporting multiple recruiters or hiring managers

- Experience working in a startup or high-growth environment

- Ability to handle confidential information with discretion

- A self-starter with a sense of ownership and urgency



If interested, please send an
 to: 
 with the subject: Recruiting Coordinator. Tell me about your coordinating experience and the hardest coordination project you've ever worked on.

title: Recruiting Manager
description:
About MZMO People Partners (MZMO)

MZMO is a women-led boutique recruiting firm dedicated to partnering with venture capital and private equity firms. We specialize in retained searches to foster deep client relationships and deliver an exceptional candidate experience.

By leveraging data-driven insights and incorporating operational excellence into our practice, we tailor each engagement to meet the unique needs of our clients. Our core values include integrity, accountability, continuous learning, clear communication, mental health, and giving back to our communities. We are committed to doing right by our clients, supporting our team, and maintaining a quality-over-quantity approach to provide focused and effective recruiting solutions.

Recruiting Manager

MZMO is seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Recruiting Manager to join our team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment and excels at managing multiple projects simultaneously. As a key contributor, you will not only source top-tier talent for a variety of clients but also coordinate the end-to-end recruitment process. This includes scheduling interviews, maintaining clear communication between candidates and clients, and ensuring a seamless experience for all parties involved. We are seeking exceptionally bright and reliable individuals who want to work in a LGBTQ+ friendly environment.

Key Responsibilities

Talent Sourcing: Using Boolean Search strategies to proactively identify and engage with potential candidates through various channels (i.e. LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, E-mail), ensuring a rich pipeline of talent for our clients

Project Management: Effectively oversee multiple talent sourcing projects concurrently, ensuring strategies are adjusted as needed to achieve weekly goals. Maintain accurate and up-to-date data to track progress and drive informed decision-making.

Candidate Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with potential candidates, communicating proactively to maintain good rapport and provide a great experience

Interview Coordination: Interacting with both clients and candidates to organize and schedule interviews across various platforms, ensuring a prompt and smooth experience.

Data Analysis and Reporting: Track and analyze outreach metrics such as response rates, relevancy and candidate engagement to identify trends and proactively address challenges. Use data insights to collaborate with clients and internal teams, ensuring realistic but ambitious weekly goals are set and met.



Ideal Qualifications

Experience: At least 3 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, with a proven track record of managing multiple projects and sourcing high-quality candidates.

Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication abilities.

Organizational Skills: Highly organized with a keen attention to detail, capable of juggling multiple projects without compromising quality.

Intellectual Curiosity: A strong desire to learn and grow, coupled with intellectual curiosity about various industries and roles.

Systems: Comfort with Google Suite, Slack, 
, LinkedIn, Octopus, E-mail Marketing





What Sets Us Apart

Growth Opportunities: We are committed to your personal and professional development, supporting your journey to become the best version of yourself.

Flexibility: We prioritize output over input, fostering a flexible and inclusive work environment.

Culture: LGBTQ Friendly & 2 paid hours of Community Service per month



Tactical Stuff

title: Web / Brand / Graphic Designer
description:
Web / Brand / Graphic Designer — PunchZero

Engagement: Part-time (20 hrs/week to start, path to full-time)

Compensation: Monthly salary + per-project performance bonus (no cap)



About PunchZero

PunchZero is a technology-enabled construction company building the next generation of commercial trade services across California. We serve national retail and restaurant brands with tenant improvement work — and we're scaling fast across LA, San Diego, Sacramento, and San Francisco.

We're not a typical construction company. We run lean, automate aggressively, and obsess over how our brand shows up — from a project proposal landing in a GC's inbox to the careers page that pulls in our next hire. This role exists because our visual identity needs to match the level of operation we're building.



The Role

We're looking for a designer who can own the entire visual surface of PunchZero — websites, brand systems, sales collateral, customer-facing tools, and the marks that go on them.

You'll work directly with the founder. There is no design team above you. You'll be expected to take a one-line brief, run the research yourself, and come back with three directions worth choosing between.

This starts part-time (~20 hrs/week) and converts to full-time once we've validated the working relationship and the work volume is there — typically within 2–4 months.



What You'll Do



Brand system. Build and evolve the PunchZero visual identity end-to-end. Logo, color, type, voice — the whole stack.

Web design. Design and ship our marketing sites, careers pages, and customer-facing product surfaces. You'll work in Figma; we have engineers for implementation.

Customer interfaces. Help us design the dashboards, portals, and tools our GC clients and field teams use. We want these to feel like consumer software, not enterprise sludge.

Sales & proposal collateral. Design proposal templates, pitch decks, one-pagers, and the digital assets our sales team uses every week.

Marketing assets. Social graphics,
 design, recruiting creative, trade-show visuals — whatever the business needs to look sharp.

Research and propose. Before designing, you'll study what the best construction tech, B2B SaaS, and consumer brands are doing — and bring back what we should steal, ignore, and invent.





What We're Looking For

Experience



2–5 years of professional design work, with a portfolio that shows range across web, brand, and graphic

Track record of shipping work end-to-end — not just concepts, but live sites, real brand books, decks that closed deals

Bonus: experience designing for B2B, construction, real estate, or trades



How you work



Operates with minimum direction. We'll tell you the outcome we need; you'll figure out the path.

Understands the business before designing for it. If you don't know what a tenant improvement is, you'll go find out.

Comes back with three options, not one. Has a point of view on which is best and why.

Communicates clearly in writing. We work async across time zones.



Tools



Expert in Figma (must)

Comfortable with Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign)

Actively uses AI design tools — Midjourney, DALL·E, Galileo, Uizard, v0, Magic Patterns, Krea, or whatever else is current. We want someone who treats AI as a leverage tool, not a threat.

Bonus: light familiarity with Webflow, Framer, or HTML/CSS so you can spec or prototype





What This Role Is Not



This is not a production design role. We're not looking for someone who needs detailed mocks to execute against.

This is not a "make it pretty" role. We need someone who'll push back on the brief when it's wrong.

This is not a stable, slow-moving environment. We move fast and ship often.





Compensation & Engagement



Base salary: Paid monthly on the last business day. First month prorated by days worked.

Performance bonus: Per-project bonuses paid the next business day after the project ships and is signed off. No cap.

Reviews: Compensation reviewed every 3–6 months.

Conversion to full-time: Evaluated at the 60–90 day mark based on output, fit, and volume of work available.





Your portfolio. Link, not PDF. We want to see live work and real outcomes.

Three pieces you're most proud of, with 2–3 sentences each on: what the brief was, what you'd do differently today, and what the result was for the business.





Screening Process

We review every application personally. Shortlisted candidates go through a two-stage process.

Stage 1 — Home task (~2–3 hours)

A small, real PunchZero design brief sent to shortlisted candidates only. AI tools are permitted and encouraged — but you'll need to defend every decision in the final interview.

Stage 2 — Final interview with the founder (45 min)

Walk through your Stage 1 work, defend your choices, and discuss how you'd approach the first 30/60/90 days.

title: Canva Presentation Designer (Part-Time / As-Needed Work for YouTube Lessons)
description:
Job Description



I run a website and YouTube channel called ManWrites, where I create English lesson content based on short stories.

I am looking for a reliable Canva presentation designer to help create clean, professional presentations for my YouTube lessons.

This is not a full-time role.

Work will be given as needed, depending on my content schedule.

If the work is good, this can become a long-term ongoing collaboration.



What You’ll Do



You will take a fully prepared text (stories and questions) and turn it into a well-formatted Canva presentation using my template.

Your main tasks will include:

    • Using a standard Canva presentation template

    • Copying and placing text into slides correctly

    • Ensuring clean layout and readability

    • Keeping all text in the top half of the slide

    • Creating natural breaks in the story across slides

    • Formatting headers and sections consistently

    • Reviewing slides for clarity, spacing, and typos

    • Combining slides if Canva splits the presentation into multiple files

    • Delivering a final, polished presentation ready for download



Important Style Requirements



    • Slides must be clear and easy to read on video

    • Avoid overcrowding (around 40 words max per slide)

    • Maintain consistent spacing and layout

    • Follow specific font sizes and header styles

    • Use judgement to create natural reading flow

You will be given examples to follow, and you should match the same style closely.

I will give you a list of clear instructions to follow too.



Requirements



    • Good experience using Canva presentations

    • Strong attention to detail

    • Good level of written English (to spot errors and formatting issues)

    • Ability to follow instructions carefully

    • Ability to work independently



Nice to Have (But Not Required)



    • Experience creating slides for YouTube or online teaching

    • Understanding of basic storytelling flow

    • Experience working with structured content (lessons, scripts, etc.)



Work Details



    • Part-time / freelance (as needed)

    • Work will come in batches (e.g. 1–3 presentations at a time)

    • Each presentation may be 150+ slides (sounds like a lot but I will provide all the text!)

    • Turnaround time will be agreed per task



Payment



Please include your rate per presentation in your application.

(You can also include a rate per hour if you prefer.)



How to Apply



Please include:

    1. A short introduction about yourself

    2. Your experience with Canva

    3. Examples of presentations you have made (very important)

    4. Your rate

    5. The word “SLIDES” at the top of your application (to show you read this properly)



Final Note



I am looking for someone reliable, consistent, and detail-focused.

If you do good work, I will continue to send you regular tasks.



I will send a small paid test task to shortlisted applicants.

title: Media Buyer Specialist (Meta-Focused)

- Cold traffic acquisition

- Audience warming via video and engagement-based campaigns

- High-intent retargeting for leads, calls, or purchases

Build layered retargeting systems that:

- Increase familiarity and trust before conversion

3. Creative Deployment & Testing

- Short-form vertical video (Reels-first mindset)

- Multiple hooks, angles, and messaging themes per offer

- Continuously test, rotate, and scale creatives based on performance data.

- Collaborate with content teams to ensure ads are aligned with audience psychology, buying intent, and funnel stage.



4. Performance Optimization & Scaling

Monitor and optimize key performance indicators, including:

- CPM, CPC, CTR

- Video hold rates and engagement

- Cost per lead, cost per booked call, and conversion rates

- Scale budgets responsibly while maintaining account stability and performance.

- Optimize campaigns based on downstream results (lead quality, sales feedback), not just surface-level metrics.

- Ensure proper implementation and maintenance of:

- Meta Pixel

- Conversions API

- Custom events and conversion tracking

- Troubleshoot tracking discrepancies in collaboration with funnel or CRM teams.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

- Strong understanding of:

- Audience psychology and buying behavior

- Content-based warming and pre-framing

- Retargeting systems and frequency management

- Ability to think strategically across the entire funnel, not just individual campaigns.

- Experience working with sales teams or lead-based businesses.

- Strong organizational, analytical, and communication skills.

- High-ticket services

- Types of offers you’ve advertised

- How you structure cold, warm, and retargeting traffic

- How you evaluate lead quality and performance beyond basic metrics

title: Auto Damage Estimator
description:
Auto Damage Estimator — Full Time | $3-$6/Hr USD

The Claim Factory |(Remote)



About Us

The Claim Factory is an independent auto damage appraisal firm based in Denver, Colorado. We work with insurance carriers, fleet managers, and adjusters across the country to deliver accurate, fast, and professional appraisal reports. We run a tight, quality-first operation and we hold our work to a high standard.



The Role

We’re hiring a full-time Auto Damage Estimator to support our appraisal workflow remotely. This is a production role — you’ll be working real claims, using real estimating software, and delivering finished work product.

This is a long-term position with room to grow. We’re looking for someone who takes their craft seriously.

Hours: Full time (40 hrs/week)

Schedule: Monday–Friday, aligned to US Mountain Time



What You’ll Do

	•	Write and review auto damage estimates using CCC ONE and/or Mitchell

	•	Support total loss documentation and appraisal report preparation

	•	Organize and label inspection photos; review photo sets for completeness

	•	Coordinate with appraisers and adjusters on file notes and open items

	•	Work within our Airtable-based claim management system



What We’re Looking For

We prefer candidates with direct experience in one or more of the following:

	•	Auto appraisal firm (independent or carrier-side)

	•	Body shop or collision repair facility

	•	Insurance claims department (auto physical damage)

	•	Salvage, fleet, or equipment valuation

We will train the right person — but you need to come in knowing the industry. If you’ve never touched an estimate, worked in a shop, or dealt with auto claims in some capacity, this role is not for you.

Software experience that matters:

	•	CCC ONE (estimating)

	•	Mitchell (estimating)

	•	Classic/Heavy Equipment estimating (a plus, not required)

	•	CompanyCam or similar photo documentation tools



To Be Considered

We get a lot of applications. Most people don’t read the post. To show us you did, include the phrase “straight line” somewhere in the first paragraph of your cover message. Applications without it will not be reviewed.

In addition, please answer the following in your application — keep it short and honest:

	1.	What estimating software have you used, and for how long?

	2.	Have you worked at a body shop, appraisal firm, or insurance company? Describe the role briefly.

	3.	What’s a supplement, and when would you write one?

	4.	What does ACV stand for, and how is it used in a total loss claim?

These are not trick questions. If you know the industry, these take two minutes.



What Good Looks Like

You’re detail-oriented. You don’t cut corners. You can work independently without someone checking on you every hour. You communicate clearly in writing. You learn fast. You care about the quality of the work — not just getting it done.

If that’s you, we want to hear from you.



To Apply

Send your application through OnlineJobs.ph with your answers to the four questions above and a brief intro. Include any relevant experience, software you’ve used, and your availability to start.

title: Video Editor (PHP 368/HR - USD $6/HR | PART Time)
description:
Hey!



We are looking for a Video Editor ROCKSTAR who will turn our long form content into high-performing short form clips and weekly YouTube videos.



We are a marketing and education company that works with English speakers and already have a team of high-performing individuals from the Philippines. Mastery of the English language is a requirement and will be tested prior to hiring.



BENEFITS INCLUDE:

- 100% remote

- Weekly pay

- USD $6 / Hour = 368 PHP / Hour

- Paid training

- No work during the weekends

- Opportunity to go from part time to full time

- We pay for the AI and creative tools you will use (Adobe, Descript, Opus Clip, Canva Pro)

- Grow with a team that values initiative, speed, and high standards



WHAT YOU WILL DO:



Short form (main focus):

- Take long form content (webinars, trainings, YouTube videos, podcasts) and turn it into short form clips for Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn

- Add attention-grabbing hooks, captions, emojis, B-roll, overlays, and pattern interrupts

- Create short testimonial videos from coaching calls, client interviews, and other raw footage

- Organize and manage video assets so clips are easy to find and reuse



Long form & channel support:

- Edit 1 piece of long form content per week (highlight key 
nts, add B-roll, overlays, and graphics)

- Publish that long form video on YouTube (upload, title, description, tags, end screens, cards)

- Create and upload custom YouTube thumbnails that drive clicks

- Handle one-off editing requests as needed (simple promos, clips, intros/outros, etc.)

- Analyze performance of published videos in YouTube Studio (CTR, views, watch time, retention) and provide simple reports and recommendations



Collaboration & cadence:

- Meet once a week with the owner of the company for feedback, direction, and priorities

- Join 1 monthly content planning session with the team

- Use AI tools (that we pay for) to speed up editing, transcription, captioning, and repurposing while still polishing by hand



Expected volume (part-time ~20 hours per week):

- 20–30 finished short form clips per week (30–90 seconds each)

- 1 edited and published long form YouTube video per week

- Ongoing testimonial edits and one-off requests as needed



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:



Experience & portfolio:

- Proven experience editing short form content from long form videos

- Strong portfolio showing:

Before/after edits from long form to short form

YouTube videos you have edited and thumbnails you have designed

Short testimonial / social proof videos (a plus)



Tool competence (we provide licenses):

You will work daily inside:

- Adobe Premiere Pro (primary editor)

- Basic Adobe After Effects (simple animations, lower thirds, transitions)

- Descript (transcription, rough cuts, repurposing)

- Opus Clip (AI clipping & short-form ideas)

- Canva Pro (YouTube thumbnails & simple graphics)

- YouTube Studio (publishing & analytics)

- Google Drive, Google Docs/Sheets (file management, tracking)

- ClickUp (task management)

- Slack (communication)



You don’t need to be a master of every tool on day one, but you must already be strong in at least one pro editor (Premiere / Final Cut / DaVinci) and be able to learn the rest quickly.

Having experience with video editing is a requirement to be considered for this role.



We will ask you what your favorite dog breed is, answer chowchow in your application so we know you have read the full job posting.



We will start with relatively limited hours (around 20 hours per week to begin) with the opportunity for it to grow as our relationship develops.



REQUIREMENTS:

- Mastery of the English language (spoken and written)

- Strong project management skills and ability to hit volume targets consistently

- Comfortable reviewing analytics and making basic performance recommendations

- Quiet environment to work



TECH REQUIREMENTS (MINIMUM):

- Computer: Windows 10/11 PC or Mac (released within the last 4–5 years)

CPU: Intel i7 / Ryzen 7 / Apple M1 or better (or equivalent)

RAM: Minimum 16 GB (32 GB strongly preferred)

Storage: At least 512 GB SSD, with 150+ GB free for active projects

GPU: Dedicated graphics card with 4 GB VRAM or more (e.g., NVIDIA GTX 1660 / RTX series or equivalent). For Mac, M1/M2 with integrated GPU is fine.



- Software capability:

Must be able to run Adobe Premiere Pro / After Effects smoothly while having multiple Chrome tabs, cloud drives, and AI tools (Descript / Opus Clip / etc.) open.



-High Speed Internet: Stable enough for uploading/downloading large video files and live calls without interruption

Reliable backup option (mobile data or secondary ISP) is a plus



- Other:

Quality headphones and microphone for edit reviews and team calls

Quiet, dedicated workspace suitable for focused editing work



If your current setup struggles with Adobe Premiere or AI tools like Descript / Opus Clip, please upgrade first before applying. This role requires fast, reliable hardware to hit our weekly volume targets.



SCHEDULE:

You must be available to work 4 hours per day, following this schedule: 3 PM – 7 PM Philippines time.



You must APPLY with this link:

title: Short Form Editor & Media Manager
description:
***At Polaris, we’re on the lookout for a driven, detail-oriented, and marketing-savvy Marketing and Acquisitions Assistant to join our world-class team. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, love the idea of being the operational backbone of a company’s marketing engine, and have strong hands-on experience with GoHighLevel, content creation, CRM systems, and social media, this role is for you.



***About us:

Polaris is a consulting agency with a bold mission: To help 1 million Founders to leverage time, reclaim freedom, and scale without sacrifice. We’re the only firm blending coaching and done-for-you services through a hybrid model — empowering our clients with strategic delegation, streamlined operations, and scalable systems. 



***Role Mission

Be the driving force behind the short-form content engine of established, fast-growing founder-led brands.

You’ll work closely with Founders and client teams to turn raw talking-head videos, b-roll, voice notes, event footage, and brand assets into high-performing short-form content for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and other social platforms.

Your work will directly help founder-led brands grow visibility, attract leads, increase audience engagement, and position themselves as trusted leaders in their industries through sharp, brand-aligned, platform-native content.



***Role Responsibilities

Short-Form Video Editing & Content Packaging

- Transform raw talking-head and b-roll footage into engaging short-form videos with strong hooks, tight pacing, clean cuts, captions, and visual emphasis.

- Edit platform-native videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and other short-form content channels.

- Create multiple short-form formats, including talking-head reels, b-roll remixes, caption-overlay reels, educational videos, founder-brand reels, and promotional clips.

- Apply strong editing judgment around rhythm, music, transitions, pattern interrupts, zooms, framing, captions, and retention-focused pacing.

- QA all videos before submission or publication to ensure clean captions, strong audio, correct formatting, brand alignment, and high-quality exports.



Graphic Design & Carousel Content

- Design branded graphics, carousel posts, quote cards, reel covers, and promotional visuals aligned with each client’s brand guidelines.

- Turn key ideas, frameworks, quotes, and educational concepts into simple, visually strong carousel content.

- Create clean caption-overlay graphics and visual assets that support short-form video and social media campaigns.

- Maintain consistency across typography, colors, layout, spacing, visual hierarchy, and overall brand style.

- Ensure every graphic or carousel feels polished, platform-native, and aligned with the founder-led brand’s voice and positioning.



Content Creation & Management

- Use AI to research trends, winning content references, viral short-form formats, competitor content, and creative angles.

- Review raw content assets to identify strong hooks, clips, 
nts, b-roll sequences, and short-form content opportunities.

- Plan and maintain a content calendar to ensure consistent, on-time publishing across social platforms.

- Organize content assets, including raw footage, b-roll, edited videos, brand photos, graphics, captions, references, and creative briefs.

- Use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity to generate first-draft hooks, captions, content angles, and short-form video ideas.



Social Media Engagement & Audience Management

- Monitor, respond to, and engage with comments, messages, and mentions across social platforms.

- Help maintain an active, consistent, and professional brand presence for founder-led brands.

- Support audience growth by identifying relevant online communities, ICP profiles, warm connections, and engagement - opportunities.

- Set up and manage simple ManyChat automations for new followers, CTA opt-ins, and follow-up flows.

- Track engagement patterns and audience feedback to identify what content is resonating and where improvements can be made.



Tracking & Reporting

- Generate regular reports on content performance, audience growth, engagement, and short-form video results.

- Track key metrics such as views, watch time, retention, saves, shares, comments, follows, profile visits, and leads generated.

- Identify which hooks, formats, topics, editing styles, and visuals are performing best.

- Provide clear insights and recommendations to improve future content performance.

- Use AI to make reporting, performance analysis, and repeatable content workflows faster and more efficient.



Role Requirements

- Minimum 3 years of virtual work experience in social media management, content management, or short-form video editing.

- Strong short-form video editing portfolio, especially for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn videos, and - founder-led personal brands.

- Proven ability to transform raw talking-head footage, b-roll, event clips, and long-form recordings into polished, engaging, high-performing short-form videos.

- Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, captions, sound design, b-roll usage, visual hierarchy, storytelling, and platform-native editing styles.

- Ability to create multiple content formats, including talking-head reels, b-roll remixes, caption-overlay reels, carousel posts, educational videos, and promotional clips.

- Proficient in tools such as CapCut, Descript, DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere Pro, Canva, Photoshop, Figma, ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Opus, or similar.

- Excellent English, strong attention to detail, proactive problem-solving skills, creative judgment, visual taste, and the ability to work independently with founder-led brands.



Role Results / KPIs

- 100% adherence to the content production calendar, including edited, approved, and scheduled short-form videos.

- Consistently strong QA pass rate on submitted content, with minimal captioning, formatting, audio, export, factual, or brand-alignment errors.

- Efficient production of high-quality short-form video edits from raw talking-head footage, b-roll, long-form videos, events, and other raw content assets.

- Consistent improvement in short-form video quality, including stronger hooks, sharper pacing, cleaner edits, better visual polish, and stronger brand alignment.

- Increased short-form content performance across views, watch time, retention, saves, shares, comments, follows, profile visits, and leads generated.

- <30-minute response time to social media comments, messages, and mentions during agreed working hours.

- Accurate reporting of content performance metrics with clear insights and recommendations to improve future content.



Work Schedule

- You will either be hired on a part-time (20hour / week) or full-time (40hour / week) basis

- Shift times would be based on the founder’s timezone, which can be across North American, European, or Australia/Asia Pacific times.

- Availability may be required around key content publishing windows, campaign launches, or time-sensitive social media engagement periods.



Compensation & Perks

- Hourly rate starting at 4 USD/hour.

- Quarterly bonus eligibility, up to 800 USD or more per year.

- Pay rise potential based on experience and performance.

- Opportunity for higher one-off project fees on top of standard salary.

- Work-from-home flexibility.

- Access to training and career development.

- Work alongside high-performing virtual teams and world-class Founders.



***HOW TO APPLY:

If you meet all the above requirements and are confident that you are a great fit for this position, submit your application by clicking on the following link:





Please do NOT private message us regarding this job. We have a hiring process in place and will only accept applicants who can follow the process.



Place the word "Editor" at the start of your full name in the application form.

title: Creative funnel builder for Funnelish
description:

mber to join our fast-growing 6-figure eCommerce business.

We are looking for someone to take ownership of one of the most important parts of our business:



Building high-converting sales funnels.



This is NOT a simple copy-paste role.



We are looking for someone who understands copywriting and can improve existing funnels strategically, not someone who blindly copies competitor funnels without understanding why they work.



You must be able to think critically, identify weak points in a funnel, improve messaging and increase conversion potential.

Your role is to take these funnels and turn them into cleaner, stronger, more polished, high-converting versions that are ready to launch and scale.

This includes:



* Product naming

* Logo creation and branding

* Improving and refining copywriting

* Creating images that strengthen the funnel

* Delivering polished funnels optimized for conversions



We care heavily about quality, creativity, speed, and attention to detail.



Meeting deadlines is extremely important.



4R MODEL - FUNNEL BUILDER



ROLE



* Use competitor funnels as inspiration, not something to blindly duplicate

* Improve structure, flow, branding, messaging, and visuals

* Understand WHY certain funnels convert and improve weak areas

* Create polished funnels that are ready to test and scale



Your work directly impacts the performance and growth of the business.



RESPONSIBILITIES



* Analyze competitor funnels and identify what makes them work

* Adapt and improve copy to fit our structure and standards

* Create supporting visuals

* Work independently and solve problems proactively

* Meet deadlines consistently

RESULTS



* Funnels that meet our KPIs and quality standards

* Clear and persuasive messaging

* Reliable and consistent delivery

* Smooth collaboration with the team



REQUIREMENTS



* Experience with Funnelish

* Basic graphic design skills (logo creation, image editing, branding)

* Ability to improve existing content instead of blindly copying it

* Perfect in English

* Organized, reliable, and deadline-driven

* Strong communication skills



IMPORTANT



When applying, please include:



* Your resume

WHAT WE OFFER



* Full-time position

* Excellent hourly pay

* KPI-based bonus system

* Accurate payment through time tracking

* Long-term role with growth opportunities

* Clear SOPs, templates, and competitor examples

* Fast-paced environment with strong learning opportunities



READY TO GROW WITH US?



If building high-converting funnels excites you and you enjoy improving and optimizing existing ideas into stronger converting versions, we would love to hear from you.
