title: Short-Form Video Editor — Per-Clip Pay, Paid Trial First, Ongoing Variable Batches
description:
A premium wealth management practice is hiring a short-form video editor for ongoing work. We pay per clip, in batches, with variable monthly volume. We start every hire with a paid trial. If your trial lands, you get the first real batch. If that lands, you get the ongoing slot.

All work is strictly confidential and requires a signed NDA before any source material is shared, including for the trial clip.

The Opportunity

Three stages:

 • Stage 1: Paid trial. $25 flat for one short cut from a 5-minute source video featuring our principals. 48-hour turnaround. Paid on submission regardless of outcome..

 • Stage 2: First real batch. Per-clip pricing (see below). Volume defined batch by batch, typically 10 source videos producing 30 to 50 finished shorts plus optional hero trailer. Quick turnaround. 

 • Stage 3: Ongoing batches at the same per-clip rate, ordered as needed. No monthly retainer.

Pricing

 • $13 per finished short (10 to 60 seconds, fully edited, captioned, branded, with required end card and disclosure)

A “finished short” means a complete, polished, on-brand clip ready for publishing. Clips shorter than 10 seconds, partial edits, or clips needing re-work to meet brand standards do not count as billable deliverables.

Example batch costs:

 • Light: 20 shorts, no trailer = $260

 • Standard: 40 shorts plus 1 trailer = $645

 • Heavy: 60 shorts plus 1 trailer = $905

Turnaround Expectations

This role is built for speed. Markets move and our clips need to ship the same week the source was filmed. Standard batch deadline is 1 week from receipt of source files. If a 1-week ceiling on 10 sources sounds tight, this is not the right role for you.

Source Material

Long-form YouTube videos, max 30 minutes each. Typical batch is 10 source videos, though volume varies month to month. Your job is to find the highest-value 
nts and turn them into shorts that work on Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and X.

The Key Skill: Graphics and Speaker Placement

We are not looking for someone who just crops landscape video down to a vertical frame. We need an editor who can:

 • Rearrange the animated graphics from the source video (lower-thirds, charts, titles, callouts) to fit the vertical frame properly

 • Reposition the speakers so heads, hands, and gestures stay centered and visible after the reframe

 • Adjust on-screen text size and placement for mobile viewing

 • Make every vertical clip look like it was shot for vertical, not letterboxed or cropped from landscape

This is the skill we need. Your portfolio must show it.

Per-Clip Deliverable

 • Pick the strongest 10 to 60 seconds from the source. Length depends on content and what will go viral.

 • Hook in the first 3 seconds, every clip, no exceptions

 • Reframe 16:9 to 9:16 with graphics and speakers repositioned properly

 • Apply our brand kit (provided on hire): gradient, lower-third, logo, end card

 • Open captions, exact transcription. Financial terms and names must be correct.

 • Required compliance disclosure on end card. Exact wording provided. Do not modify.

Hero Trailer (When Commissioned)

60-second cinematic montage across the batch’s source videos. Strong opening hook, pacing-driven cuts, on-brand motion graphics. Not included in every batch.

Required Skills

 • Professional video editing software of your choice. CapCut Desktop Pro, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or other. Whatever delivers the result.

 • Strong portfolio in vertical short-form (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) that demonstrates graphics rearrangement and speaker repositioning, not just cropping

 • Demonstrated eye for hooks and pacing

 • Reliable English communication, 24-hour weekday response time

 • Bandwidth to commit to 1-week turnarounds on variable batch sizes

 • Willingness to sign and abide by an NDA

Bonus

 • Experience editing financial, business, or educational content

 • Motion graphics for chart and quote overlays

 • Overlap with US Eastern Time hours

How to Apply

Send:

 1. Three samples of vertical short-form clips (links). Pick samples that show graphics rearrangement and speaker repositioning, not just cropping.

 2. One sample of a trailer or sizzle reel

 3. Confirmation you will sign an NDA and complete the $25 paid trial first

 4. Confirmation you can commit to 1-week turnarounds on variable batch sizes

Selection Process

We will short-list candidates for 20-minute video interviews.

Looking for one editor for a long-term relationship. Reliable, fast, graphics-skilled, hook-driven work.

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

- Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field

[Preferred Experience]

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

mbers

mber who understands the current workflow

title: Executive Assistant / Operations Manager — US Real Estate Broker
description:
Executive Assistant / Operations Manager — US Real Estate Broker (Full-Time, Long-Term)

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Time (US West Coast hours) Compensation: $1,500–$2,500/month depending on experience Start: Immediately Type: Full-time, long-term position with growth potential





Who I Am

I'm a licensed California real estate broker running two separate businesses:



A brokerage in a small California market — established team, rental property management, active listings. This business runs but needs better systems and less of my personal time.



A luxury real estate operation in the South Bay of Los Angeles — newer, high-growth focus targeting $5M–$10M properties. This is where I'm building aggressively and need to spend more of my time in the field.



I'm also building AI-powered automation tools for my business (chatbots, CRM automations, content systems). I don't need you to code — but I need someone who's comfortable working alongside AI tools and isn't intimidated by new technology.





Who I'm Looking For

I don't need a task-taker who waits for instructions. I need a proactive operator who can:



Watch how I work, identify what's wasting my time, and pull it off my plate — without me having to explain every task. You'll spend your first 2 weeks shadowing my workflow, documenting what I do, and building the SOPs we don't have yet.



Keep me accountable. I'm a visionary — I'm great at strategy and big-picture thinking but I struggle with disciplined daily execution. I need someone who will say "Jonathan, you committed to doing X this week and you haven't. What's blocking you?" That's not overstepping — that's your job.



Be a sounding board. I think out loud. I need someone who can listen, take notes, organize my ideas into action items, and follow up to make sure they happen.



Run the day-to-day operations so I can focus on the activities that directly generate revenue — meeting with clients, building relationships, filming content, and closing deals.





What You'll Do (Starting Week 1)

 & Communication Management



Triage my inbox daily — flag urgent items, draft responses, archive noise

Manage communications with my team of agents (fielding routine questions so they don't all come to me)

Coordinate with tenants on maintenance requests, route to the right vendor, follow up until resolved



Calendar & Schedule Management



Own my calendar — block time for prospecting, content creation, builder meetings

Protect my high-value time blocks from getting eaten by low-priority tasks

Schedule appointments, showings, and follow-ups



CRM & Lead Management



Keep our CRM updated (add new leads, update statuses, log notes from my calls)

Monitor incoming leads and ensure nothing falls through the cracks

Track follow-up sequences and flag when someone needs attention



Systems & SOPs



Document every repeatable process as you learn it

Build checklists and templates for recurring tasks

Identify bottlenecks and suggest improvements — I want you thinking about how to make the business run better, not just executing tasks



Project & Task Tracking



Maintain a master task list and project tracker

Send me a daily end-of-day summary: what got done, what's pending, what needs my attention tomorrow

Track progress on longer-term projects and flag when deadlines are slipping



Content & Marketing Support



Help schedule and post social media content using templates and existing assets

Assist with Canva-based graphics (we have templates — you'd customize, not design from scratch)

Coordinate content calendar across platforms



AI Tool Collaboration



Work alongside our AI automation tools — you'll interact with chatbots, review AI-generated content, and help manage automated workflows

You don't need to code, but you need to be comfortable with AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude, and be willing to learn new platforms quickly





Tools You'll Use Daily

Gmail & Google Calendar —
, scheduling

GoHighLevel (GHL) — CRM, automations, pipeline management

Sierra Interactive — real estate CRM

Follow Up Boss (FUB) — lead management

Mojo Sells — dialer platform

WhatsApp — team communication

Canva — marketing graphics

ChatGPT / Claude — AI tools for content and operations

 — bot notifications and team updates



You don't need to know all of these on day one, but you should be the kind of person who can learn a new platform in a day or two without hand-holding.





What Makes You the Right Fit

Must-haves:



Excellent written and spoken English

Available Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Time (this is non-negotiable)

Proactive and self-directed — you see something that needs doing and you do it

Highly organized with strong attention to detail

Comfortable giving direct feedback and holding someone accountable

Tech-savvy — quick to learn new tools, comfortable with AI

Reliable internet connection and quiet workspace

At least 2 years of experience as a VA, EA, or operations assistant



Strong preferences:



Experience in US real estate (understanding of transactions, listings, CRM workflows)

Experience managing a calendar and inbox for a busy executive

Experience building SOPs and documenting processes

Experience with GoHighLevel, Follow Up Boss, or similar real estate CRMs

Familiarity with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, automation platforms)



Personality traits that matter more than resume lines:



You're the person your friends call "the organized one"

You're not afraid to speak up when something isn't working

You take ownership — if you touch it, you own the outcome

You're resourceful — you Google it before you ask

You genuinely enjoy making chaos into order





What You Get

Stable, long-term position — I'm not looking for project help, I'm looking for my right hand

Growth potential — as the business scales, this role grows into a true Operations Manager position with more responsibility and higher compensation

Direct access to the business owner — you're not reporting to a middle manager, you're working directly with me

Interesting work — real estate, AI, automation, content marketing. This isn't data entry.

A boss who values your input — I want you to think, not just execute





How to Apply

Do not send a generic application. I will ignore it.



Instead, send me a message that includes:



A short paragraph (3–5 sentences) about why this role specifically interests you — not why you're a great VA in general, but why THIS role.



One example of a time you proactively identified a problem in a previous job and fixed it without being asked.



Your experience with any of the tools listed above — just a quick list of which ones you've used.



Your honest answer to this question: "If your boss told you they were going to do something important this week and then didn't do it, what would you do?"



Your expected monthly salary in USD.



I review every application personally. If your application shows me you actually read this post and thought about it, you'll hear back fro
.

title: Amazon Operations Manager

You'll own the platform end-to-end across our key marketplaces (US, CA, MX, UK, AU, JP). Every listing, every metric, every routine, every deal. You'll cross-check our supply chain. You'll spend roughly one day a week building AI agents and automations that make the function leaner over time. And you'll have full access to Claude and whatever comes next.



This isn't a coordinator role. It's an operator role. If you've already run Amazon ops for a brand at real scale and you want more autonomy, smarter tools, and a founder who'll get out of your way once you've earned it, read on.





YOU SHOULD APPLY IF



You've personally run an Amazon ops function before for a brand doing meaningful volume — owning the operation, not just executing tasks within someone else's

You've run Amazon ops across multiple international marketplaces (not just the US). You understand the quirks of each: VAT, regional compliance, marketplace-specific listing rules, marketplace-specific image uploads, global review sharing etc.

You're AI-fluent. You actively use Claude or similar in your daily work, you're comfortable with agentic workflows, and you can build and refine prompts. Having built automations is a bonus, not required.

You're a natural systems thinker. When you describe past work, you talk in workflows, inputs, decisions, and edge cases

You have deep working knowledge of Seller Central — listings, GTINs, barcodes, FNSKUs, A+ content, brand stores, account health, deals and promotions setup

You're a process person. You believe in checklists, SOPs, and consistent routines

Your written and spoken English is excellent



DON'T APPLY IF

title: Bookkeeper / Accountant  – Permanent Full Time
description:
# Remote Bookkeeper — Full-Time



We're hiring a full-time remote bookkeeper to run project invoicing, payments, and reconciliation in QuickBooks Online. Accuracy and consistency are the entire job.



---



## The kind of bookkeeping



This is project-based B2B bookkeeping. Customer payments come in two stages — typically 50?posit at order, balance before delivery. Supplier payments mirror that structure where required (deposit to start production, balance once production is complete). Some suppliers are on net 30 terms; every bill is PO-driven. The business operates between Canada and the US.



If your background is SaaS, retail, or subscription bookkeeping, this is a different rhythm — closer to construction, manufacturing, or project-based services.



---



## Compensation & Hours



- **Full-time, 40 hours/week**

- Hourly rate: **$5–10/hr** depending on experience

- Permanent role



---



## What you'll do



**Project invoicing (QBO)**

When a customer pays a deposit or design fee, trigger the project sequence: create the Project under the customer using the next sequential project code, move the Estimate into the Project, convert it to an Invoice, and record the payment. Apply every payment to the correct invoice and project.



**Accounts Payable**

- Match every supplier bill to its PO before entering in QBO

- Create payment orders in RBC PayEdge — COO approves before they go out

- Time supplier final payments correctly: the customer's final payment must clear before the supplier's balance is paid



**Contractors**

- Reconcile contractor invoices against Time Doctor hours before payment

- Pay contractors on schedule



**Accounts Receivable**

- Collect customer payments and follow up on outstanding balances

- Track every receipt to the correct invoice and project



**Communication**

- Monitor finance-related from customers, suppliers, and the internal team

- Coordinate with the team in Slack — no silent backlogs

- Email customers and suppliers





---



## Tools



QuickBooks Online, RBC PayEdge, Time Doctor, Slack, Asana, Excel / Google Sheets.



---



## What "good" looks like



- Zero unapplied payments. Zero duplicate customer records. Zero sloppy project coding.

- Every supplier bill matched to a PO before payment.

- Every supplier final balance paid only after the customer's payment has cleared.

- Audit trail clean enough that anyone can open a project and understand what happened.

- Asana tasks moved as work progresses — never silent for days.



---



## Requirements



- Proven QuickBooks Online experience (Projects, Estimates, Invoices, Bills, POs)

- Strong accounts payable discipline (PO matching, bill creation, payment recording)

- Strong written English and clear communication

- High attention to detail — you catch mismatched totals and missed steps before anyone else does

- Comfortable working inside documented SOPs and Asana-driven workflows — you follow the process and flag deviations rather than freelancing

- Strong preference for experience with deposit-based project billing, supplier net terms, and cross-border (Canada/US) operations

- Ecommerce bookkeeping experience is an asset, not a requirement



---



## Schedule



- Remote

- Full-time, Monday to Friday

- Minimum 4 hours of daily overlap with 9am–5pm Eastern Time



---



## To apply



In your intro message, include:



1. Expected hourly rate and years of QBO experience

2. Availability in Eastern Time

3. Resume

title: Outbound Cold Caller — US Market
description:
What This Job Is:

This is a high-volume outbound cold calling role. You will make 80–100 calls per day to US business owners, follow a provided script, and book 20-minute appointments for our founder. That is the entire job.

If you are comfortable on the phone, handle rejection without losing energy, and are motivated by earning more when you perform better — keep reading.

If you are looking for customer service, lead research, or a relaxed work-from-home job — this is not the right fit.



About Us:

We build workflow automation for service businesses in the US. Business owners love it because they stop losing jobs to voi
. We are growing fast and need callers who can get US business owners on the phone and excited about a quick demo.



Your Daily Responsibilities

• Make 80–100 outbound calls per day to US business owners using our provided lead list

• Follow the script, qualify the prospect, and book a 20-minute call with our founder

• Handle objections professionally and stay persistent without being pushy

• Log every call outcome accurately in a shared Google Sheet

• Attend a short daily check-in and flag anything that needs attention



What You Will NOT Do

• Close deals yourself — your only job is to book the appointment

• Research leads — we provide the full contact list

• Do admin, customer service, or account management



What You Earn

Base salary plus performance bonuses. The more you book, the more you earn.



• Base: $300–$400 USD/month depending on experience

• $10 USD for every discovery call that shows up

• $20 USD for every deal that closes after your booked call

• $30 USD bonus if you personally close the deal yourself



What earnings look like in practice:

• Solid month — 20 showed calls + 6 closes + base: ~$670 USD

• Strong month — 40 showed calls + 12 closes + base: ~$1,040 USD

• Top month — 60 showed calls + 18 closes + base: ~$1,360 USD



Payments are bi-weekly via Wise. Base is guaranteed. Bonuses are paid when conditions are met.



What We Are Looking For

• Clear, professional spoken English easily understood by US business owners

• Real outbound cold calling experience — B2B preferred

• Ability to make 80+ calls per day and stay sharp throughout

• Reliable internet and a quiet workspace

• Available during US business hours (Eastern or Central time)

• Honest with call logging — we verify using recorded calls



Tools We Provide

• Full lead list with verified US business owner contact details

• JustCall account with a US phone number — all calls made and recorded through this system

• Call script and objection handling guide

• Google Sheet for daily logging



How to Apply

Your application must include two things. Missing either one means your application will not be reviewed.



1. A 30-second voice introduction

Record yourself saying your name, where you are from, how many years of cold calling experience you have, and one sentence about why you are good on the phone. Upload to Google Drive or Dropbox and share the link.



2. One sentence answering this question

What is the most calls you have made in a single day, and what were you selling?



* Applications without a voice recording will not be considered regardless of experience. This is non-negotiable — your voice is your tool and we need to hear it before we can move forward.



Shortlisted candidates will be sent a second script to record as a final step before an interview.



A Note from the Founder

I run a lean operation and work directly with everyone on the team. If you book good calls and help close deals, I will know your name and you will earn accordingly. There is no cap on what you can make — the more you produce, the more you earn, and the top performers will have first access to better opportunities as we grow.



If that sounds like your kind of environment, I want to hear from you.



- Matt -

title: Virtual Associate Lawyer - Legal & Administrative Focus
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Virtual Associate Lawyer — Legal & Administrative Focus

Civil Litigation | Employment Law | AI-Integrated Practice



Position Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated Virtual Associate Lawyer to join our growing practice in Civil Litigation and Employment Law. This is a remote-first role for a tech-forward legal professional who embraces AI-assisted legal work as a core part of their practice.



The role will begin with a combination of substantive legal work and administrative tasks, with opportunities to expand into higher-level responsibilities as trust and performance are demonstrated. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, resourceful, and eager to contribute to a dynamic, high-value legal practice—and genuinely enthusiastic about leveraging AI tools to produce superior work product faster.



AI-Integrated Practice: This firm actively uses AI platforms—including Claude.ai, ChatGPT, and Eve—as integral tools in daily legal work. Candidates must be comfortable and proficient with these platforms, using them to accelerate research, drafting, and case evaluation while maintaining the judgment and oversight required of a licensed legal professional.



Key Responsibilities

Initial responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:



Legal Drafting & Research

• Conduct in-depth legal research and prepare accurate, well-reasoned legal memoranda

• Draft and review Employment Demand Letters, Complaints, and Discovery (to Plaintiff/Defendant)

• Assist with preparation and review of legal documents for civil litigation and employment matters

• Revise and refine AI-generated drafts to meet professional legal standards and firm voice



AI-Assisted Case Evaluation

• Input and analyze intake materials, employee files, and employer responses into Eve and/or Claude.ai for systematic case evaluation

• Apply prompt engineering techniques to extract structured legal analysis from AI tools

• Critically review AI-generated output for accuracy, legal sufficiency, and strategic alignment

• Document AI-assisted workflows and help refine firm protocols for AI use in legal practice



Case & File Management

• Assist with client intake, case tracking, and digital file management

• Prepare and manage correspondence, deadlines, and calendaring

• Support client communications throughout the lifecycle of each case

• Learn and implement firm systems to improve operational efficiency



Writing Sample Required: Please provide writing samples demonstrating your ability to draft Complaints, Demand Letters, and Discovery requests. Samples that reflect AI-assisted drafting (with your own editing and refinement) are welcome and encouraged.



Qualifications

Required

• Law degree (J.D. or foreign equivalent)

• Strong legal research, writing, and organizational skills

• Demonstrated proficiency with AI legal tools—specifically Claude.ai, ChatGPT, and Eve—for drafting, research, and case analysis

• Ability to critically evaluate and refine AI-generated content to meet professional legal standards

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Comfortable working in a fully virtual environment using cloud-based tools and case management systems

• Proactive, problem-solving mindset with strong deadline management skills



Preferred

• Bar admission (any U.S. jurisdiction); not required at the outset

• Prior experience in civil litigation or employment law

• Familiarity with prompt engineering or structured AI workflows in a legal context

• Experience with virtual law firm operations and remote collaboration tools



Why Join Us

This role is designed for a forward-thinking legal professional who sees AI not as a threat to legal work, but as a force multiplier. You will help shape how our firm integrates AI into legal practice—gaining skills and experience that are increasingly rare and valuable in the legal market.





To apply, please submit your resume, a brief cover letter, and writing samples.
